finalText:
**Build is clean.** Exit 0, `0 errors`.

Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:

- [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) read `options.retries`, but the bundler now sends `retryCount`. Threw on `undefined.toFixed`.
- [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) treated unset `backoffEnabled` as invalid instead of `false`. Threw on missing flags.

The rest was deprecation noise, unchanged.

Next: nothing.
